description: Presidential Secretaries  - Appointed Mrs. D. A. Siriweera as Assistant Secretary, w.e.f. 11.12.2017 Appointed Mr. S. P. P. Wijesinghe as an Assistant Director, w.e.f. 06.12.2017 to the President Staff.
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel appointments (Mrs. D. A. Siriweera as Assistant Secretary and Mr. S. P. P. Wijesinghe as Assistant Director) with basic titles only, without any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes.
